You spotted it — that 2G reading is almost certainly the culprit. 2G is a very old data technology that can carry plain SMS texts, but it generally can't handle picture messages. So this nicely explains why regular texts work while photo messages don't.

The good news is this is a phone-side setting we can change right away.

**Please do this:**

1. Open **Settings** → **Network & internet** (or **Connections** → **Mobile networks**, depending on your phone).
2. Find **Network mode** / **Preferred network mode**.
3. Change it from 2G to **5G / 4G (auto)** — often shown as "5G/LTE preferred" or "4G_5G_preferred". If 5G isn't an option on that screen, choose **4G/LTE** — that alone is more than enough for MMS.
